facts: VivoTab is a series of Microsoft Windows hybrid tablet computers.
VivoTab is a sub - series of the Vivo series by Asus.
The name is derived from the Latin word " to live ".
Asus's Transformer series of convertible devices runs Windows.
The name, along with Asus's Transformer series of convertible devices running Windows, is a primary competitor to the Microsoft Surface.
The VivoTab family is made up of the VivoTab, VivoTab RT, VivoTab RT 3 G, VivoTab RT LTE, VivoTab Smart, and later on the VivoTab Note 8.
The VivoTab Note 8 comes with Windows 8.1.
All of the tablets come with a 3-year subscription to Asus WebStorage.
All of the tablets have high definition screens.
All of the tablets advertise ultra - portability.
All of the tablets advertise extended battery life.
VivoTab RT has an MSRP of $ 599 USD ( 32 GB ).
VivoTab RT has an MSRP of $ 699 ( 64 GB ).
